a: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا ۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
p: Man jā'a bi-l-ḥasanati fa-lahu ʿashru amthālihā, wa man jā'a bi-s-sayyi'ati fa-lā yujzā illā mithlahā…
m: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
